description:
Greetings,

I am passionate in neuromarketing,AI,eye-tracking and EEG devices applied in marketing,the adaptability of humans in different natural conditions,economical and new worlds exploratory missions.I truly believe that the Greatest Power of humans is the Power to Overachieve their Passions.
summary:
I developed a software for mission members only using EEG and CSV Databases.ai repports and interpretation.
The painfull problem that Veronica,my daughter challenged me is :Astronaut dies or not dies.The astronaut does not have time to read the instruction manual and uses the application which provides a 4 steps based logical scheme on the main factors selected.
By doing this,it eliminates the interpretation of medical analysis and this reduces the risk of dying by 80% because of quick time of finding the solution.By using AI repports interpretation in 20 seconds generates the 4-step logical scheme to save the astronauts lifes
The software is mission restricted only for astronauts.
The software is mission restricted only for astronauts.
It delivers AI human physical conditions for each EEG and Heart individualy and comparatively to generate a 4 steps logical scheme to solve a life and death situation.
details:
First the astronauts upload the EEG and ECG repports.Then AI agent gives a Repport Interpretation.The pysical data are introduced in Crisis Menu that generates 4 steps procedure.Final decision is to astronaut after 60 seconds analyis of human data by software.

I focus on creating a Beta software,test IT with raw data of humans and in the future to use for saving human lives.

The tools and databases used are csv.test EEG files, NASA database of heart from APOLLO mission;video demo Canva,Wondershare democreator8, piano for playing the song,domain creation and software design with my database using Lovable and AI tools build by Veronica's idea.

The song is called Ballade pour Adelline Richard Clayderman sing by Cristiana Chiriac,team owner.

We focused on 3 factors - Simplicity,Speed Solution for Life and Death Incidents,Intuitivity.

In conclusion the software responds to the challenge as a puzzle that a child,Veronica of 8 years old can solve on spaceship.
